summary: Tested Batch Spy feature end-to-end. Backend pytest (4/4 pass): 401 without auth, 404 for bad client_id, 400 when <2 competitors, and full happy path — POST /api/ads/batch-spy returns ranking (>=2 items), market_gaps, beat_them_all, winning_strategy, and campaign_brief.ads with exactly 3 ads each having hook/headline/primary_text/cta/image_prompt; GET list includes the new run (no _id leak); DELETE removes it. Frontend E2E via Playwright: admin login OK → opened first client → tab-batchspy visible with Crosshair icon → batch-spy container renders 3 spy-row-* inputs → 'Add competitor' appends a 4th row → clicking Beat them all with 0 filled shows 'at least 2' toast and does not fire the API → filled 3 realistic HVAC competitor ads and ran; result card rendered with ranking bars, market_gaps, beat_them_all, winning_strategy, and 3 spy-ad-* cards each with spy-copy-adcopy-0/spy-copy-prompt-0 buttons plus a raw Higgsfield prompt box (6 labels found for 3 ads * 2 places). Copy buttons clicked without errors (toast fires). Page reload preserved the run via GET, and clicking the trash icon deleted it (DOM node removed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1170 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (ads, angles, batch_spy, creatives, clients, auth) for maintainability.
ClientTools.jsx is ~643 lines with multiple exported components (AdCreator, AdIntel, BatchSpy, SalesCoach, ClientReports) — consider splitting into per-feature files to reduce coupling.
BatchSpy.remove() has no error toast on failed DELETE (silent failure); minor UX polish.

The Higgsfield prompt is rendered TWICE — once in the bordered box (per spec) and again implicitly inside <AdVisual/> which itself shows the prompt + Generate button. Not a bug per the request (raw prompt box is required), but slightly redundant visually.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created and deleted one TEST batch-spy run against ABC HVAC (or first client). Frontend E2E created one run on TEST_E2E_HVAC and deleted it via UI. No lingering test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch Spy feature fully validated (backend + UI + copy buttons + persistence + delete). Higgsfield 'Generate image' error inside AdVisual is expected (out of credits) and not part of this scope; copy Higgsfield prompt buttons work independently as required.
